title: Sales By Representative Expanded CSV and PDF look as designed
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have two active staff members at the test location with their "Sales Representative" switch on, so that a work order can have a different Labor and Parts representative.
  • Use a customer with no Sales Representative assigned.
  • Have, today, one invoiced split work order for that customer (Labor set to one of them, Parts set to the other) and one invoiced part sale.
  • Set the browser window to 1440 pixels wide with the zoom at 100%.
  • Open the design pictures "sbr-11-a4-export-csv.png" (board 4.11) and "sbr-12-a4-export-pdf-crop-1.png" (board 4.12) attached to this case beside the browser window at 100% (actual size). Names, numbers and dates in the pictures are sample data.
  • Open Reports > Sales By Representative in that browser window, with the Sales Type column off.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Export the Expanded CSV and compare it with the picture of board 4.11.
  2. Export the Expanded PDF and compare it with the picture of board 4.12.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The file has the Sales Type column right after Status (and before any Location column), even though it is off on screen.
  • The cells of the side a row is not credited with are blank.
  • The part sale's labor and hours cells are blank too.

Step 2:

  • The PDF has the Sales Type column in the same place.
  • Those cells, and the part sale's labor and hours cells, show a dash.
  • The header lines name the filters, including "Sales Type: All".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11269 (Story 5, Credit each side on the invoice and in Sales By Representative), story SV-11272 (Story 8, Filter both sales reports by Sales Type)

  • S5-R15b: “On a Part Sales row, Labor Delta, Labor Invoiced and Labor Margin, and the labor and hours cells of the Expanded downloads, show a dash on screen and in the PDF and are blank in the CSV. A part sale has no labor, so these columns don't apply to it.”
  • S5-R23: “The Expanded CSV and the Expanded PDF always carry the Sales Type column, after Status and before Location, whatever the screen shows. In them, the cells of the side a row is not credited with are blank in the CSV and show a dash in the PDF.”
  • S8-R4: “The filter line at the top of every PDF and CSV export of Sales By Representative reads the same: "Sales Type: All", or the selected names. With no option selected there is nothing to export: Export shows "Empty export" and makes no file. Any other export with no rows, for example a date range with no invoices, still downloads a file with the headings and no rows, as today.”

From: Chris Ward's answers to the Splitting Sales Representatives question sheet (answers 1 to 38, 19 Oct 2026; answers 39 and 40, 21 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Chris Ward's answer 24: “24. (a) as the feature spec: a dash on screen and in the PDF, an empty cell in the CSV. The 0.0 rule still applies to an invoice with one person on both sides.”
  • Chris Ward's answer 26: “26. (a) Status, Sales Type, Location.”
  • Chris Ward's answer 39: “39. (a) A dash on screen and in the PDF, and an empty cell in the CSV, as the design shows. A part sale has no labor, so the labor columns don't apply to it; it's the same rule as answers 24 and 25. This changes today's 0.00 / $0.00, so it's now listed under Release day. New S5-R15b, PRD v11.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Claude design canvas "Splitting Sales Representatives" (https://claude.ai/artifact/8MHqwyffAYtqZ6EccS5RUm), export read 19 Oct 2026, boards 4.11 Expanded export (CSV); 4.12 Expanded export (PDF) (the attached pictures are these boards).

Where the design and the PRD differ: The export pictures show 0.00 / $0.00 under Shop Supplies on the Parts row. Chris Ward ruled on 19 Oct 2026 for the PRD: blank in the CSV and a dash in the PDF (answer 24, quoted above); this case follows it.

Design pictures attached to this case: sbr-11-a4-export-csv.png, sbr-12-a4-export-pdf-crop-1.png.

  • Design — board 4.11 title: “4.11 Expanded export (CSV)”
  • Design — board 4.11 note: “Downloaded with the Sales Type column switched off on screen: the file still has Sales Type (decision 40). An empty side is a blank cell. (Shown as a spreadsheet would open it.)”
  • Design — board 4.12 title: “4.12 Expanded export (PDF)”
  • Design — board 4.12 note: “The PDF always has the Sales Type column. An empty side shows a dash. Header lines name the filters, including "Sales Type: All".”
